This document outlines the major maintenance 
procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block

The HP steam turbine control valve is used to regulate 
the steam flow rate. It occurs through surface variations between the actuator 
and the seat. They are designed to create the least possible pressure drops.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem, tested by eng. Esam Darwish, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng 
Samir Abd El Gilil, approved by general 
director eng. Mohamed Anan and accepted by eng. Mohamed Elsarrag head sector 
of Damietta PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Be sure that the turbine is out of service and 
 turning gear is off.

Be sure that the all electrical & instrumentation 
 cables are completely isolated.
Be sure that the fire fighting system is isolated.
Isolate the valve mechanically and electrically.
Be sure that the oil system is completely isolated.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Spray.
Wires for lifting.
Cleaning articles.
Filler and Vernier.

Dismantle the connecting pipes between HP upper 
 casing and stop / control valve block.
Disconnect all electrical connections.
Disconnect all hydraulic and pneumatic connections.

Mark exact position of valve and actuator stem in 
 the stem coupling to facilitate reassembly.
Measure the stroke of the valve and record it.

Remove stem coupling between actuator and valve 
 stem.
Remove the actuator by the crane.
Remove the nuts (25011G).
Remove the cup nuts (25031C) by heating.

Unbolt all the bolts (25011A) fix the valve body 
 with the turbine.
Sling and lift the valve body to be disassembled.

Disassemble the heat protector (25031Y) by unbolting 
 the screws (25032A) and lift it.
Raise the part (25032C).
Unbolt the bolts (25031W).
Pull up the plug with the bonnet.
Raise the plug from the bonnet by unscrewing it.
Take out the bonnet(25020C).
Raise the two steam seal (25020G).
Raise the part (25031A).
Raise the rings ( 25102N & 25102Q) respectively.
Raise the part (25035A).

Raise the other rings ( 25102N & 25102Q) 
 respectively.
Raise the part (25031C).

Degrease all parts of the valve with non corrosive 
 product and rags.

Clean carefully all the parts with adequate products 
 and solvents.
Clean all screws, pins and nuts by solar.

Examine visually the valve components for wear, 
 cracks, deformations, foreign bodies, etc .

Change the plug, metallic rings, steam seal rings 
 and the bonnet.
Machine the valve seat carefully.
Inspect the valve parts by magnetic test.
Make blue test between the bonnet and the seat.
Sand blast the parts of the valve.
Sand blast the bolts, screws and nuts of the valve.

Before the assembly, we must coat the mating faces, 
 pins, keys and screws active faces with COPASLIP.
Assemble the part (25031C).
Assemble the rings ( 25102N & 25102Q) respectively.
Assemble the part (25035A).

Assemble the other rings ( 25102N & 25102Q) 
 respectively.
Assemble the part (25031A).
Lock the part (25031A).
Screw the plug in the bonnet.
Insert the bonnet with the plug in the valve body.
Assemble the two steam seal in the bonnet.
Lock the plug in the bonnet.

Make a blue test to actuate the clearances between 
 the bonnet and the seat.
Tight the screws (25031W).
Put the heat protector (25031Y).
Put the part (25011G).
Tight the screws (25032A).

Tight the screws (25011A), put the cup nut (25011C) 
 and tight the nut (25011G). Use a heating plug for tightening.

Assemble the stem coupling between actuator and 
 valve stem.
Assemble the actuator and tight it.
Measure and adjust the stroke of the actuator.
Connect all hydraulic and pneumatic connections.
Connect all electrical connections.

Mantle the connecting pipes between HP upper casing 
 and HP stop/ control valve block.

Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance 
procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block
The HP steam turbine control valve is used to regulate 
the steam flow rate. It occurs through surface variations between the actuator 
and the seat. They are designed to create the least possible pressure drops.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel

Samir Abd El Gilil, approved by general 
director eng. Mohamed Anan and accepted by eng. Mohamed Elsarrag head sector 
of Damietta PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

 turning gear is off.
Be sure that the all electrical & instrumentation

Be sure that the fire fighting system is isolated.
Isolate the valve mechanically and electrically.
Be sure that the oil system is completely isolated.
